brand_voice_note: Cheeky, founder-forward and warm, claiming her nickname with playful confidence while tying every promise back to real pizza and real ingredients.

copy_claims: includes free semi circle pizza paddles
a bamboo pizza peel, scraper and rose gold pizza cutter
concepts.primary_text:
Not sure you've got everything you need? You do now.

The Starter Kit is the oven plus free paddles, a bamboo peel, scraper, rose gold cutter and an apron - the whole setup in one box.

Free shipping too.
concepts.headline: The whole pizza setup, sorted
concepts.why_it_works: The bundle's one advantage over the single ovens is completeness, so a labelled callout of each included piece kills the 'do I need to buy extras' hesitation before the click.
concepts.visual_direction: An overhead flat-lay of the full Starter Kit - pink grill, bamboo peel, semi-circle paddles, rose gold cutter, scraper and folded apron - with four labels pointing to the key pieces.

concepts.product_title: THE PIZZA GIRL PIZZA GRILL - PG PINK
copy_claims: make your perfect pizza in under 5 minutes
top and bottom heating elements plus a ceramic stone base
Dual heating controls for a crispy or chewy bottom and bubbly top
concepts.primary_text:
Say goodbye to sad, rubbery oven pizza.

My Pizza Grill has top and bottom heating elements plus a ceramic stone base, so you get your perfect pizza in under 5 minutes with minimal effort.

Dual heating controls mean crispy or chewy on the bottom and bubbly on top. Fresh, hot, real pizza - no more cold takeaway. 🍕
concepts.headline: Real pizza in under 5 minutes
concepts.why_it_works: The pink oven's whole reason to exist is fixing bad home pizza, so showing the sad-vs-perfect result in one frame lands the promise harder than any pretty product shot.
concepts.visual_direction: The open pink grill on a kitchen counter with a hot bubbly pizza on its stone beside a sad, limp oven-baked slice on a plate.

concepts.product_title: KIDS - Pink Corduroy Team Pizza Girl Cap
concepts.primary_text:
Team Pizza Girl has a new littlest member.

Soft pink corduroy, a slouchy fit and 'Pizza Girl' stitched right across the front - a pizza kids favorite.

Because pizza night is a whole-family thing, and now they can look the part too.
concepts.headline: For your tiniest pizza chef
concepts.why_it_works: The cap is the only kids item, so leaning on the family pizza-night moment with a warm detail-led shot of the corduroy craft sells the team feeling rather than performance.
concepts.visual_direction: The pink corduroy kids cap resting on a maker's workbench beside black thread, scissors and matching corduroy scraps in soft window light.
